question: Show the name, email, city and country of all customers from India
reference_sql: SELECT name, email, city, country FROM customers WHERE country = 'India';

question: List the product id, product name, category id, unit price and stock quantity for all products
reference_sql: SELECT product_id, product_name, category_id, unit_price, stock_quantity FROM products;

question: Show all orders with status Delivered
Show the top 5 customers by total spending
reference_sql: SELECT c.name, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) AS total_spending FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.name ORDER BY total_spending DESC LIMIT 5;

question: Which product generated the highest revenue?
reference_sql: SELECT p.product_name, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) AS total_revenue FROM products p JOIN order_items oi ON p.product_id = oi.product_id GROUP BY p.product_id, p.product_name ORDER BY total_revenue DESC LIMIT 1;

question: What is the total revenue by product category?
reference_sql: SELECT c.category_name, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) AS total_revenue FROM categories c JOIN products p ON c.category_id = p.category_id JOIN order_items oi ON p.product_id = oi.product_id GROUP BY c.category_id, c.category_name;

question: Which country has the highest number of customers?
reference_sql: SELECT country FROM customers GROUP BY country ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1;

question: What is the average order value?
reference_sql: SELECT AVG(order_total) AS average_order_value FROM (SELECT order_id, SUM(quantity * unit_price) AS order_total FROM order_items GROUP BY order_id) AS order_totals;

question: Which customer has spent the most on laptop products?
reference_sql: SELECT c.name, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) AS total_spent FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id JOIN categories cat ON p.category_id = cat.category_id WHERE cat.category_name = 'Laptops' GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.name ORDER BY total_spent DESC LIMIT 1;

question: Which products have never been ordered?
reference_sql: SELECT p.product_name FROM products p LEFT JOIN order_items oi ON p.product_id = oi.product_id WHERE oi.product_id IS NULL;
